name: Interactable
description: Something the player can use: a lever, a pickup, a conversation. The prompt is shown on screen while the player looks at it.

methods.name: prompt
methods.doc: The text shown to the player, such as Open door.

methods.name: can_interact
methods.doc: Whether this player may use it right now (a locked door says no).

methods.name: interact
methods.doc: The player used it, from position.
